title: France's Borrowing Costs Top America's as Prefects Ban Marches
dek: France's 10-year yield broke 5% for the first time since 2002 as the budget returns to the National Assembly on 27 October.
body: The OAT-Bund spread hit about 175 bp on 22 October, the widest since 2011. It eased to about 156 bp on Monday.

panels.label: The Government Says
panels.text: Lescure says France has “two safety rails” to pass a budget: Article 49.3 and ordinances.

panels.label: Unions and Students Say
panels.text: Binet says the government can stop the marches if it will “respond immediately to the demands.”

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One side calls the cuts a debt rescue, the other a squeeze on schools and wages; at stake is who carries France's deficit.
